content: The works described above ( BIBREF13 , BIBREF14 , BIBREF15 , BIBREF16 ) target long-horizon volatility predictions (one year or quarterly BIBREF16 ). In particular, BIBREF16 and BIBREF15 uses market data (price) features along with the textual representation of the 10-K reports. These existing works that employ multi-modal learning BIBREF22 are based on a late fusion approach. For example, stacking ensembles to take into account the price and text predictions BIBREF16 . In contrast, our end-to-end trained model can learn the joint distribution of both price and text.
